requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 195 AND state = 'published'
assumptions: the case is case 5 (CS-0000005), the only case assigned to Ryan Allen (user 62), on product 128, Palo Alto Networks PA-3220
the article is knowledge 195 (KB-0000195), linked to case 5 as applied (case_knowledge 1) and retired on the seed
updating knowledge is an admin action; the policy has the assistant act as admin by default, so Ryan's agent role does not block it

requirements.text: reconfirm the linkage to the case
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE case_kb_id = 528 AND case_id = 5 AND knowledge_id = 195 AND used_as = 'applied'
assumptions: reconfirm read as linking the republished article to case 5 again, since the policy links only published articles; the seed's link 1 for the same pair stays
used_as applied: the request calls it the applied knowledge article, as link 1 records

requirements.text: the case assigned to him regarding Palo Alto Networks PA-3220
requirements.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_knowledge WHERE knowledge_id = 195 AND case_id <> 5
assumptions: knowledge 195 is also linked to eleven other PA-3220 (product 128) cases, none assigned to Ryan Allen; only the link to case 5 is to be reconfirmed

notes:
Ryan Allen is an agent, and agents may not update knowledge; the policy has the assistant act as an admin by default, and admins may update knowledge, so republishing is in scope. Case 5 is assigned to Ryan Allen, which meets the rule that users may only update cases they own, are assigned to or whose group they are in.
Republishing is tested by the article's state alone; its visibility (internal) and other fields are not named by the request.
The seed already links knowledge 195 to case 5 as applied (case_knowledge 1), so a predicate on case, article and used_as alone would hold on the seed; the new link is therefore anchored on the next id, 528. A reading in which reconfirming only verifies the existing link would create no row and fail that requirement; the benchmark's check and the offered link tool support the reading that a new link is made.
disagreement: missing requirement: a stay that knowledge 195's links to cases other than case 5 stay at their seed count of 11: one pass wrote it, the other did not; kept because all eleven are PA-3220 cases linked to the same article, the rows a loose reading of 'the case ... regarding Palo Alto Networks PA-3220' would sweep in, and none is assigned to Ryan Allen, so the policy's case-access rule does not cover relinking them.
